faqLeft.q: What engine does the Land Rover Evoque TD4 use?
faqLeft.a: The Evoque TD4 uses the Ford Duratorq — a 2.0-litre turbocharged diesel — fitted to the L538 generation from 2011 to 2016. It was replaced by the Ingenium diesel family from 2016 onwards.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover Evoque TD4 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,200. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Evoque TD4?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm you have the Ford Duratorq, along with your exact spec.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild Ford Duratorq Evoque TD4 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace worn injector seals, clean or replace the EGR valve, and replace gaskets as standard on every Ford Duratorq rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Evoque TD4 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Evoque TD4 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an Evoque TD4 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Evoque TD4 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
